component.name: Arca
component.summary: A fast file manager for Wayland

description.p: Arca is a fast, keyboard-first file manager for Wayland, built on the optics graphics stack. It is designed as a companion application for the Tessera desktop while remaining fully standalone across any Wayland compositor.

ul.li: Three viewing modes: icon grid, detailed sortable list, and Miller columns
Off-thread thumbnail generation for images and audio files (FLAC/MP3 cover art)
Quick Look preview overlay for instant file and metadata inspection
Independent tabbed navigation and customizable bookmarks
FreeDesktop Trash specification compliance with full restore support
Integrated XDG Desktop Portal file chooser prompter and standalone CLI picker
Live system light and dark color scheme synchronization
